---
title: "Sponsors"
subtitle: "Who holds every MLS club's front of kit, sleeve and stadium name, and which industries are buying"
description: "A sourced directory of MLS club sponsors, the sponsor-category landscape, and who sells stadium naming rights."
---

```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import charts
from charts import raw_html

directory = charts.query("SELECT * FROM mart_sponsor_directory")
missing_article = charts.query(
    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_brand WHERE wikipedia_article IS NULL").iloc[0, 0]
n = len(directory)
cover = {col: int(directory[col].notna().sum())
         for col in ["front_of_kit_brand", "sleeve_brand", "stadium_brand"]}
```

## Who sponsors each club?

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"Front-of-kit partner recorded for **{cover['front_of_kit_brand']} of {n}** clubs, "
      f"sleeve partner for **{cover['sleeve_brand']} of {n}**, stadium naming partner for "
      f"**{cover['stadium_brand']} of {n}**. \"Not recorded\" means no sourced deal: some "
      "stadiums have no paid name (Montréal's Stade Saputo carries the owner's company name), "
      "and some sleeves are unsold or unconfirmed. Search or filter below; every row links to "
      "its source.\n")
print(raw_html(charts.sponsor_directory() or "<p>The dataset has no clubs yet.</p>"))
```

## Which categories buy MLS's biggest assets?

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.category_landscape(), "landscape",
                           "The dataset has no current deals yet.")))
```

Most health care deals are regional hospital systems on the kit of their home
club, such as Emory Healthcare in Atlanta, UCHealth in Colorado and MD Anderson in
Houston. A category belongs to the brand, not the deal, so a bank on a
kit and a bank on a stadium both count as banking.

## Who sells the stadium name?

Most clubs own or control their stadium and sell its name themselves. A few play
in an NFL or university stadium whose naming rights belong to the venue, so the
sponsor bought the building, not the club. Comparing the two shows what kinds of
brands each kind of seller attracts.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.card(charts.stadium_by_seller(), "stadium-seller",
                           "No stadium naming deals recorded yet.")))
```
